title: What happened in AI — Oct 8, 2026
intro: Claude Haiku 5.5 is reported to beat GPT-6 Luna at the same price, and Anthropic also launched a Cyber Mission and a new Usage Policy.
For builders, agent tooling got more operable: payments through Stripe's Link, crash reporting for coding agents, and Spotify's multi-agent guardrail patterns.
highlights: Claude Haiku 5.5 reportedly beats GPT-6 Luna at the same pricing.
LangSmith Fine-Tuning and the SmithTune CLI target post-training specialized models.
Cloudflare open-sources Clef, 9B and 27B models that pick between predefined options.
Agents can now pay: Restock uses Stripe's Link over the Machine Payments Protocol.
Anthropic ships a 2026 Usage Policy and a Cyber Mission; OpenAI disrupts two influence operations.
Google launches the Gemini agent; DeepSeek reportedly nears a $12 billion round.
